description.en_US: Allows you to change the Optional Reagents and quality of equipment crafted with Midnight Alchemy.
description.es_MX: Te permite cambiar los componentes opcionales y la calidad del equipamiento fabricado con alquimia de Midnight.
description.pt_BR: Permite alterar os reagentes opcionais e a qualidade de alguns equipamentos criados com Alquimia de Midnight.
description.de_DE: Ermöglicht Euch, das optionale Reagenz und die Qualität von Ausrüstung zu ändern, die mit Alchemie von Midnight hergestellt wurde.
description.en_GB: Allows you to change the Optional Reagents and quality of equipment crafted with Midnight Alchemy.

description.ko_KR: 한밤 연금술로 만든 장비의 선택 재료와 품질을 변경할 수 있도록 합니다.
description.zh_TW: 讓你可以更換額外材料，並改變至暗之夜鍊金術製作裝備的品質。
